featured_reviews.name: Ashmeet singh banga
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Unprofessional and Unreliable Pricing

I had a very bad experience with Sharda printers (Deonath, Chembur). Initially, I was quoted ₹18 per sheet. As soon as I started taking their service, the price was revised to ₹22 within a day or two.

When I questioned the sudden increase, I was told ₹22 was the “minimum,” yet after discussion they agreed again to ₹18—only to keep insisting later that they were “already charging less than others.” To avoid issues, I finally agreed to ₹22.

Shockingly, the rate was again revised to ₹30 per sheet without any justification.

After a few months, when I returned for a small requirement, I was charged ₹50 for just 1 sheets, which is more than double the original quoted price.

This shows a clear pattern of arbitrary price changes depending on the customer, with no transparency or consistency. This kind of business practice feels misleading and exploitative.

I strongly advise others to confirm prices in writing before taking any service or consider more professional alternatives.
